stop_rule: Reject when even the role-wise oracle over the frozen first/second-order XOR and modular recurrences plus one/four-template generators exceeds any information threshold. Do not sweep template count, layer grouping, recurrence order, residual operator, dtype, or thresholds after results. Reopening requires a generator whose program size is sublinear in both layer count and matrix area, or a causal execution dependency that avoids reconstructing exact weights.
claim_boundary: This no-forward Gate tests exact checkpoint description length across all MLP layers. Dense arithmetic, complete operation replacement, successor state, CUDA, 405B, 8 GiB, and physical latency remain NOT TESTED.
